why: Actual pre-active factory has no AuthorityService. Stage-zero key receipt is short lived, process-local seals are not durable choices, and model-store template is a release member, not executable module. This supplies one source-intent signer bridge using the existing selected authority key.

key_custody.semantics: Root composition calls while genuine stage-zero key receipt and publication handoff are current; independently resolves actual normal setup/session predecessor adoption, same installed release/actor/key_id/key device+inode. Retains held existing key FD and protected selection/private binding digest into normal session journal. No key export, second key, key rotation, parallel AuthorityService or extension of stage-zero receipt expiry.
key_custody.resume_checks: Genuine current resumed RootSetupSessionStore authorization/installed actor/controller, retained signed normal-session adoption record and exact persisted /etc/hermes-installer/authority-key-selection.json identity; securely reopen existing /etc/hermes-installer/authority.key root0/0600 nofollow, verify exact device/inode/private key-binding digest and key_id. Missing/changed key/adoption is unavailable; never auto-create or repair.

choice_registry.store: ProtectedRootJournal child setup-choices, root0 private atomic nofollow records; choice canonical UTF8 JSON sorted keys compact separators; signature domain hermes-installer.setup-choice.v1 distinct runtime source/effect/consent domains.
choice_registry.signer_interface: RootSetupChoiceSigner.sign_choice(purpose,canonical_record_bytes) and verify_choice(purpose,canonical_record_bytes,signature); finite supported purposes only memory-service-enablement, memory-capture-configuration, private-input-routes, public-free-web-read, existing-model-selection, native-policy-preparation, application-qualification. Caller never chooses algorithm/key/path/domain or signs effect/runtime receipts.
choice_registry.record_rules: private_profile_selection_handle nullable only purposes not private-profile-bound. adoption_publication_receipt_handle null until actual publication adoption. Exact purpose-specific closed payload remains existing v107/v124/v127/v137/v138 schema, not generic authority labels. Genuine root TTY choice/controller/source member observations required before recording; handles minted/retained by registry membership. No secret in record.
choice_registry.methods: record_observed_choice(actual_root_tty_choice, current_setup_selection)->opaque selection_handle; resolve_current_setup_choice(selection_handle,expected_purpose)->short current root choice snapshot; revoke_choice(selection_handle)->epoch; adopt_published_choice(selection_handle,actual_active_publication_receipt)->durable active selection handle. These are root-only concrete source producer/consumer methods, not worker RPC.
choice_registry.currentness: Stable record identity survives short principal/namespace snapshot refresh; every use freshly resolves same v133 subject/groups/System/policy/profile/namespace/controller and source template, current epoch/revocation. No old snapshot extends, boot-safe journal unix deadlines with current boot/session proof; expired setup cannot revive a grant.
choice_registry.adoption: Actual active publisher verifies and retains signed source record digest/key provenance and exact selected profile/namespace/current generation projection, then signs adoption with genuine publication receipt. Runtime AuthorityService may issue fresh <=30s purpose-specific receipts only after current active adoption/source/epoch checks. Runtime grants never use process-local setup seal or historical setup controller as worker identity.

held_source_member.model_store_template: RootExistingModelStoreTemplateReceipt from factory resolve_existing_model_store_template()/read_current; held verified installer release descriptor exact role existing-model-store-root-template, path/SHA/size/canonical fixed root bytes. Not RootReleaseModuleReceipt.
held_source_member.other_templates: Equivalent genuine selected release member observation for literal source templates; executable source adapters continue actual RootReleaseModuleReceipt. Source member receipt verifies current held bytes before choice and publication; no fabricated generic registry.
